lines.en: label mayafestival2:
Maya and I leave the house together and begin to make our way to a festival at-
lines.zh: 我和 Maya 一起出了门，动身前往一场祭典，地点在——

lines.en: : Wait, where is this festival exactly?
lines.zh: : 等等，这祭典到底在哪儿？

lines.en: : Far away.
lines.zh: : 很远。

lines.en: : Well, as far as we can go within the confines of Kumon-mi, that is.
lines.zh: : 准确地说，是在 Kumon-mi 的范围内能到的最远处。

lines.en: : There’s one closer, but I didn’t want to risk the chance of someone seeing me with you in public and thinking we like each other.
lines.zh: : 近一点的地方也有一个，但我不想冒险被人看见我跟你一起出现在公共场合，然后觉得我们互相喜欢。

lines.en: : We do like each other, though.
lines.zh: : 可我们确实互相喜欢啊。

lines.en: : No. You like me. It’s different.
lines.zh: : 不。是你喜欢我。这不一样。

lines.en: : Don’t worry too much about where it is as there’s not much reason to ever go back.
lines.zh: : 别太在意在哪儿，反正也没什么理由再去第二次。

lines.en: : The surrounding areas have mostly closed down anyway since the school building there is no longer in use.
lines.zh: : 那一带本来也差不多荒废了，因为那边的校舍已经不再使用。

lines.en: : Are we taking the bus, then?
lines.zh: : 那我们是坐巴士去？

lines.en: : Partly. We’ll have to walk for about half an hour after we get off since the bus doesn’t stop where we’re actually headed anymore.
lines.zh: : 一半是。下车后还得走半小时左右，因为巴士已经不在我们要去的那一站停了。

lines.en: : The more I hear about this place, the more I think this is some elaborate ploy for you to kill me.
lines.zh: : 这地方我越听越觉得，是你为了杀我而精心设计的圈套。

lines.en: : There are much easier ways for me to kill you.
lines.zh: : 我要杀你有的是更省事的办法。

lines.en: : But in the event that I am just looking for a challenge, you should at least thank me first for allowing you to see me in my yukata in your final moments.
lines.zh: : 不过万一我只是想找点乐子，你临终前好歹该先谢谢我，让你见到了我穿浴衣的样子。

lines.en: : Oh well. I’ve had a good run.
lines.zh: : 唉，我这辈子也算值了。

lines.en: Anyway, we leave the house together and begin to make our way to a festival at some undisclosed location far away from my house that buses pretend doesn’t exist for some reason.
lines.zh: 总之，我们一起出了门，动身前往某个未公开地点的祭典，离我家很远，而且不知为何巴士都当那个地方不存在。

lines.en: It’s confusing, yes. But so is literally everything about this city and I am tired of trying to attribute meaning to any of it.
lines.zh: 确实让人摸不着头脑。但这座城市里的一切都让人摸不着头脑，我已经懒得去给任何一件事强加意义了。

lines.en: And, like Maya says, there’s no reason for me to ever go back. So I might as well just stop thinking about it and try to enjoy the rest of the day with her.
lines.zh: 而且就像 Maya 说的，也没有任何理由再去第二次。所以我干脆别想了，试着好好跟她把今天剩下的时间过完。

lines.en: If we ever make it there, that is.
lines.zh: 如果我们真能走到那儿的话。

lines.en: At this rate, I-
lines.zh: 照这个速度，我——

lines.en: scene smileex
scene tree3
scene mayafestival1
: Oh. We’re here.
lines.zh: : 哦。到了。

lines.en: A swarm of lights surrounds us, both natural and artificial, and the scents of various street foods assault my senses.
lines.zh: 成片的灯光包围了我们，有天然的也有人造的，各种路边摊的香气扑面而来。

lines.en: I still haven’t eaten anything on account of Maya claiming my breakfast as her own, so I’m starting to get a little hungry and hope that my companion here doesn’t empty my bank account out on herself.
lines.zh: 我还没吃任何东西，因为 Maya 把我的早餐据为己有了，所以我开始有点饿，只希望身边这位同伴别把我的银行账户刷空在她自己身上。

lines.en: Upon closer observation, I can tell this is somewhere I haven’t been before.
lines.zh: 仔细一看，我能确定这是个我从没来过的地方。

lines.en: But, like many things, it feels familiar.
lines.zh: 但就像很多东西一样，它给人一种熟悉感。

lines.en: Even Maya’s presence feels familiar, so...maybe this is somewhere we’ve gone together in the past?
lines.zh: 连 Maya 的存在都显得熟悉，所以……也许这是我们以前一起来过的地方？

lines.en: : Hey. If buses don’t come here and there’s no reason to ever visit this part of town, how do you know about it?
lines.zh: : 我说。既然巴士不来这儿，也没有任何理由来这一带，你是怎么知道的？

lines.en: : I know every nook and cranny of Kumon-mi. I just choose to avoid most of them.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 的每一个角落我都知道。我只是选择避开其中大部分。

lines.en: : Have we ever come here together before?
lines.zh: : 我们以前一起来过这儿吗？

lines.en: : I’m not going to answer that. If you trick me into allowing you to commit suicide-by-memory on my birthday, I will never forgive you.
lines.zh: : 我不会回答这个。如果你骗我，好让我在你生日那天用回忆来自杀，我绝对不会原谅你。

lines.en: : This place just feels a little familiar. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得这地方有点熟悉。就这样。

lines.en: : Perhaps it is, then.
lines.zh: : 那也许是吧。

lines.en: scene mayafestival2
: Anyway, I’ll be taking your credit card now.
lines.zh: : 总之，你的信用卡现在归我了。

lines.en: : Fine. I will be taking your credit card, {i}please.{/i}
lines.zh: : 好吧。{i}请{/i}——把你的信用卡给我。

lines.en: : Give me your fucking credit card. I’m hungry.
lines.zh: : 把你他妈的信用卡给我。我饿了。

lines.en: : Do they even take credit cards here? This place seems pretty traditional.
lines.zh: : 这种地方能刷信用卡吗？看起来挺传统的。

lines.en: : ATMs exist, you know. Just give me the card.
lines.zh: : 有取款机的，好吗。把卡给我就是了。

lines.en: : This doesn’t sound very much like “spending time together.”
lines.zh: : 这听起来可不太像“共度时光”。

lines.en: : Do you see how many stalls there are here? We’ll never be able to hit all of them if we stick together.
lines.zh: : 你看见这儿有多少摊位了吗？要是我们俩黏在一块儿，是绝对逛不完的。

lines.en: : This festival has two halves. I need you to handle all of the stalls on the west side while I handle all of the ones on the east.
lines.zh: : 这场祭典分东西两半。西边所有摊位归你，东边的归我。

lines.en: : Card. Now. Give.
lines.zh: : 卡。现在。给。

lines.en: : At least tell me what you want me to order for you first.
lines.zh: : 至少先告诉我，你要我替你点什么。

lines.en: : Yes.
: Not really a yes or no question, Maya.
lines.zh: : 这可不是能用是或否回答的问题，Maya。

lines.en: : You see, that is where you are wrong.
lines.zh: : 你看，你错就错在这儿。

lines.en: : You never wanted me here at all, did you? I’m just the only person you know with a credit card.
lines.zh: : 你根本就没想让我来，对吧？我只是你认识的人里唯一有信用卡的那个。

lines.en: scene mayafestival3
: If I say no and promise to...catch goldfish with you or something once I’m done eating, will you give it to me?
lines.zh: : 如果我拒绝，但答应……等我吃完陪你捞金鱼什么的，你会把卡给我吗？

lines.en: : I don’t have the time to take care of a goldfish.
lines.zh: : 我没时间养金鱼。

lines.en: : It’s a goldfish. You put it in water. That’s literally it.
lines.zh: : 那是金鱼啊。放水里就行了。就这么点事。

lines.en: : I feel like you’re supposed to feed it occasionally too.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你偶尔也该喂喂它吧。

lines.en: scene mayafestival4
: Why do you care more about feeding your hypothetical goldfish than me? I am much more attractive and fun to be around.
lines.zh: : 为什么你关心喂你那条假想的金鱼胜过关心我？我可比它好看多了，也好玩多了。

lines.en: : Attractive, sure. But I think you might be overestimating how fun you are.
lines.zh: : 好看，没错。但我觉得你可能高估了自己的有趣程度。

lines.en: : I think {i}you{/i} might be overestimating how fun a goldfish is. Card, please.
lines.zh: : 我觉得{i}你{/i}可能高估了金鱼的有趣程度。卡，谢谢。

lines.en: : This is not a joke. We have already wasted far too much time.
lines.zh: : 这不是在开玩笑。我们已经浪费太多时间了。

lines.en: : Fine. But at least tell me where the two of us are supposed to meet back up. I don’t want to risk losing you in this crowd.
lines.zh: : 好吧。但至少告诉我我们俩待会儿在哪儿碰头。我可不想在这人堆里把你弄丢。

lines.en: scene mayafestival5
: There’s a gazebo near the entrance with some picnic tables. Just meet me there.
lines.zh: : 入口附近有座凉亭，旁边有几张野餐桌。就在那儿等我。

lines.en: : Also, what crowd? There’s barely anyone here yet.
lines.zh: : 还有，什么人堆？这儿根本没几个人。

lines.en: : And “getting separated at the festival” is far too tropey for real life when we both know that any drama to spring up today will be from you saying or doing something disgusting.
lines.zh: : 而且“在祭典上走散”这种桥段在现实里太老套了，反正你我都清楚，今天真要出什么幺蛾子，也只会是你说了或做了什么恶心事。

lines.en: : Sure hope I don’t accidentally get anyone pregnant while buying your lunch.
lines.zh: : 但愿我在给你买午饭的时候不会不小心让谁怀孕。

lines.en: scene mayafestival6
: Have I ever told you how much I hate you?
lines.zh: : 我跟你说过我有多恨你吗？

lines.en: : Plenty of times.
lines.zh: : 说过很多次了。

lines.en: : Just making sure.
lines.zh: : 确认一下而已。

lines.en: scene black
I give Maya one of my credit cards and thank whoever I was in the past for being responsible enough to carry two of them.
lines.zh: 我把其中一张信用卡给了 Maya，并且在心里感谢过去那个还算靠谱、随身带了两张卡的自己。

lines.en: Her ponytail bounces up and down as she runs off and, honestly, it’s probably the most active I’ve ever seen her apart from a few fantasies I don’t want to tell you about.
lines.zh: 她跑开时马尾一甩一甩的，说实话，除了几个我不想告诉你的幻想场景外，这大概是我见过她最有活力的时候。

lines.en: I stop in my tracks for a moment and observe my surroundings one more time before going in the opposite direction of Maya when I realize something.
lines.zh: 正要往 Maya 的反方向走时，我停下脚步，又环顾了一次四周，然后意识到一件事。

lines.en: I don’t think we’re in the old district right now.
lines.zh: 我觉得我们现在不在旧城区。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: I don’t think we’re in the new one either?
lines.zh: 我觉得我们也不在新城区？

lines.en: Where is this place?
lines.zh: 这到底是什么地方？

lines.en: : You there!
lines.zh: : 那边那位！

lines.en: : You look like the kinda guy who could use a nice pair of melons!
lines.zh: : 你看起来像是需要一对好瓜的人！

lines.en: scene mayafestival7
: We’ve got normal melons! We’ve got {i}square{/i} melons! We’ve got {i}triangle{/i} melons! Any kinda melon you can dream of!
lines.zh: : 我们有普通形状的瓜！有{i}方{/i}瓜！有{i}三角{/i}瓜！你能想到的任何形状的瓜都有！

lines.en: : So long as it’s one of those three shapes. Anything else, you’re gonna have to join the waitlist for.
lines.zh: : 只要是这三种形状就行。别的形状嘛，你得排候补名单。

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
: Wait...I’ve seen you before.
lines.zh: : 等等……我以前见过你。

lines.en: scene mayafestival8
: Oh?
: Yeah. Didn’t we bump into each other in the middle of the night once or something?
lines.zh: : 对啊。我们不是有次半夜撞见过吗？

lines.en: : Hmm...yeah! You were the guy with the phone!
lines.zh: : 嗯……对！你就是那个拿着手机的家伙！

lines.en: : That isn’t exactly how I would describe myself, but yes. I was the guy with the phone.
lines.zh: : 我可不会这么形容自己，不过没错。我就是那个拿着手机的家伙。

lines.en: : Glad to see you made it back in one piece.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到你完好无损地回来了。

lines.en: : And I’m glad to see you’re a...melon salesperson.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴看到你是个……卖瓜的。

lines.en: : Oh, this? This is just a temporary thing.
lines.zh: : 哦，这个？这只是临时的活儿。

lines.en: : I don’t even really like fruit.
lines.zh: : 我其实连水果都不怎么喜欢。

lines.en: : Well, you have chosen a very peculiar line of work then.
lines.zh: : 那你可真是挑了个相当特别的营生。

lines.en: else:
: What other shapes would they even come in?
lines.zh: : 瓜还能有什么别的形状？

lines.en: : Beats me. But if you join the waitlist, you can probably find out.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。不过你要是排了候补名单，大概就能知道了。

lines.en: : So, is it melon time? Or is it {i}not{/i} melon time? I’ve got a very limited supply, you know.
lines.zh: : 那么，现在是买瓜时间吗？还是{i}不是{/i}？我存货可不多，你知道吗。

lines.en: : It is most certainly “melon time,” but I think I should ask you to confirm the quality of said melons since the girl I’m here with today is a bit of a connoisseur.
lines.zh: : 现在当然是“买瓜时间”，不过我想请你确认一下这些瓜的品质，因为今天跟我一起来的那位姑娘算是个行家。

lines.en: : Wanna give ‘em a squeeze and find out?
lines.zh: : 要不要捏两下试试？

lines.en: : That depends on whether or not the police will get involved.
lines.zh: : 那得看警察会不会介入。

lines.en: scene mayafestival9
: Ahh, we’ve got a pervert on our hands! That’s great! I’ve worked with you types before.
lines.zh: : 啊哈，遇上变态了！太好了！我以前跟你们这号人打过交道。

lines.en: : There are a lot of us in the melon trade.
lines.zh: : 我们这行里变态可多了。

lines.en: : You know what? For today and today only, I’ll throw in a second melon half-off. One for the two of you to share.
lines.zh: : 这样吧，仅限今天，我再加一个瓜，半价。给你们俩分着吃。

lines.en: : If she even wants to share, that is. As a melon connoisseur myself, I understand how tough it can be to share what you love with other people!
lines.zh: : 前提是她愿意分就是了。我自己也是瓜类行家，我懂把自己喜欢的东西分给别人有多难！

lines.en: : How much are they?
lines.zh: : 多少钱？

lines.en: scene mayafestival10
: They’re...uhh...
: You don’t know the price of your own products?
lines.zh: : 你不知道自己卖的东西多少钱？

lines.en: scene mayafestival11
: Six million!
lines.zh: : 六百万！

lines.en: : Yen?
lines.zh: : 日元？

lines.en: : Pesos!
lines.zh: : 比索！

lines.en: : I don’t think I have any of those on me.
lines.zh: : 我身上好像没带那种钱。

lines.en: : How does 500 yen sound?
lines.zh: : 500 日元怎么样？

lines.en: scene mayafestival12
: 500? That’s it? These melons are easily worth double that. I think. Probably.
lines.zh: : 500？就这？这些瓜随便都能值两倍价。我觉得。大概吧。

lines.en: : This is my first day on the job, so I’m not really sure. But that also means you have to be nice to me since I’m nervous and my feelings are easily hurt.
lines.zh: : 今天是我第一天上班，所以我也不太确定。不过这也意味着你得对我好一点，因为我紧张，而且我很容易受伤。

lines.en: : Then...1,000 yen for two melons. Post discount.
lines.zh: : 那……两个瓜 1,000 日元。折后价。

lines.en: scene mayafestival13
: Deal! Would you like these gift wrapped? I’ll do it myself for...oh, I don’t know...an extra six million pesos?
lines.zh: : 成交！要礼品包装吗？我可以亲自来包，收费嘛……哦，我不知道……再加六百万比索？

lines.en: : You seem dead set on that specific number and...currency. Mind if I ask why?
lines.zh: : 你好像对这个数字和……币种特别执着。能问问为什么吗？

lines.en: : A magician never reveals her secrets!
lines.zh: : 魔术师绝不透露自己的秘密！

lines.en: : You’re a magician now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是魔术师了？

lines.en: : And an astronaut!
lines.zh: : 还是宇航员！

lines.en: : But right now, melons matter most!
lines.zh: : 不过眼下，瓜最重要！

lines.en: : I’m going to say no to the gift wrapping, but I wouldn’t mind getting your name.
lines.zh: : 礼品包装我就不要了，不过我倒是想知道你的名字。

lines.en: scene mayafestival14
: My name? Why?
lines.zh: : 我的名字？为什么？

lines.en: : Are you flirting with me? Does the sale hinge on this?
lines.zh: : 你是在跟我搭讪吗？这买卖非得问这个？

lines.en: : No. It’s just to satisfy my own curiosity.
lines.zh: : 不是。只是为了满足我自己的好奇心。

lines.en: scene mayafestival15
: My name, huh...
lines.zh: : 我的名字啊……

lines.en: : Is there a problem with that?
lines.zh: : 这有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : It’s just that nobody’s ever asked me before.
lines.zh: : 只是从来没有人问过我。

lines.en: : I find it hard to believe that no one’s ever asked you for your name.
lines.zh: : 我很难相信从来没人问过你的名字。

lines.en: : Hey, you can believe whatever you want to believe. You don’t have to pick up all the stuff I put down, Mr. Pervert.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你爱信什么信什么。我放下什么你不必都捡起来，变态先生。

lines.en: : Please don’t call me that.
lines.zh: : 别这么叫我。

lines.en: : Nope. That’s your name now. You have to live with it.
lines.zh: : 不。这就是你的名字了。你就认了吧。

lines.en: : {i}This is the part where you tell me yours.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}现在该你告诉我你的名字了。{/i}

lines.en: scene mayafestival8
: Nope! This is the part where I don’t tell you and you still buy my melons anyway!
lines.zh: : 不！现在这段是我不告诉你，而你还照样买我的瓜！

lines.en: : Can I at least have the first letter?
lines.zh: : 至少给我第一个字母行吗？

lines.en: : Nope! All I’ll tell you is that it’s really funny.
lines.zh: : 不行！我只能告诉你，这名字特别好笑。

lines.en: : Your name is?
lines.zh: : 你的名字是？

lines.en: : Hilarious. A real kick to the shin.
lines.zh: : 滑稽至极。简直让人想踹一脚。

lines.en: : Then I apologize for how much you likely get made fun of in school.
lines.zh: : 那我为你大概在学校里没少被嘲笑表示同情。

lines.en: scene mayafestival16
: Who says I go to school?
lines.zh: : 谁说我在上学了？

lines.en: : You don’t? I just thought you looked a little young.
lines.zh: : 你没在上学？我只是觉得你看起来有点小。

lines.en: : Oooooh, is {i}that{/i} why you’re flirting with me? Cause I remind you of your students?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，{i}所以{/i}你才跟我搭讪？因为我让你想起你的学生？

lines.en: : That’s not-
lines.zh: : 那不是——

lines.en: scene mayafestival17
: Wait, how did you know I’m a teacher? I don’t remember telling you that.
lines.zh: : 等等，你怎么知道我是老师？我不记得跟你说过。

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhh...hahahah!
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃……哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Two melons coming right up!
lines.zh: : 两个瓜马上就好！

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我不——

lines.en: scene smileex
scene tree3
scene mayafestival18
: Oh, good. You’re back.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。你回来了。

lines.en: Smile Count: 4
lines.zh: 微笑计数：4

lines.en: : Welp, there goes Ami’s college fund.
lines.zh: : 唉，Ami 的大学基金就这么没了。

lines.en: : Oh, please. Ami’s never going to college. No one is.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。Ami 才不会上大学呢。谁都不会。

lines.en: : How can you even eat all of this?
lines.zh: : 你怎么可能吃得了这么多？

lines.en: : I’m a growing girl.
lines.zh: : 我还在长身体呢。

lines.en: : Or at least I would be if it weren’t for the whole time loop thing.
lines.zh: : 要不是因为时间循环这档子事，我大概确实还在长。

lines.en: : I guess I’m just doomed to be eternally hungry.
lines.zh: : 看来我注定要永远饿着了。

lines.en: : So, what did you bring me?
lines.zh: : 那么，你给我带了什么？

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
: Something I think you’re going to be very happy about.
lines.zh: : 有样东西，我觉得你一定会很高兴。

lines.en: Thankfully, one of the vendors saw me struggling to carry an entire buffet’s worth of food and let me borrow a shopping cart they were using to store extra ingredients.
lines.zh: 幸好有个摊贩看我搬着相当于一整桌自助餐的食物很吃力，就把他们用来放备用食材的购物车借给了我。

lines.en: And I’m glad they did- because there is no way I would have been able to carry two large melons in addition to the variety of hot dishes I got.
lines.zh: 我真庆幸他们借了——因为除了各式各样的热食之外，我还得抱着两个大瓜，根本不可能拿得动。

lines.en: scene mayafestival19
: Happy birthday, Maya.
lines.zh: : 生日快乐，Maya。

lines.en: : Ah! Melon!
lines.zh: : 啊！瓜！

lines.en: : Two melons.
lines.zh: : 两个瓜。

lines.en: : Two melons!
lines.zh: : 两个瓜！

lines.en: scene mayafestival20
: Where in the world did you even find those? I asked every single vendor I bought from if anyone here was selling any and they all said no.
lines.zh: : 你到底从哪儿弄来的？我每买一家就问一次这儿有没有人卖瓜，他们全都说没有。

lines.en: : Some weird girl was selling them. She had other shapes, too. And a...melon waitlist or something?
lines.zh: : 有个奇怪的姑娘在卖。她那儿还有别的形状。还有个什么……瓜类候补名单？

lines.en: scene mayafestival21
: Was there really a booth like that here?...
lines.zh: : 这儿真有那样一个摊位吗？……

lines.en: : I had no idea.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道。

lines.en: : We’ll have to stop again before we leave.
lines.zh: : 走之前我们得再去一趟。

lines.en: scene mayafestival18
: Anyway, what else? I already know I’m saving the melons for last.
lines.zh: : 总之，还有什么？我知道瓜是要留到最后吃的。

lines.en: else:
Thankfully, one of the vendors saw me struggling to carry an entire buffet’s worth of food and let me borrow a shopping cart they were using to store extra ingredients.
lines.zh: 幸好有个摊贩看我搬着相当于一整桌自助餐的食物很吃力，就把他们用来放备用食材的购物车借给了我。

lines.en: And I’m glad they did- because there is no way I would have been able to carry all of this without some form of transportation.
lines.zh: 我真庆幸他们借了——因为要没有个代步工具，我根本不可能把这些全搬过来。

lines.en: : There’s...croquettes...taiyaki...some weird potato-on-a-stick thing...whatever {i}this{/i} is...some other things I don’t know the name of...and a live squid.
lines.zh: : 有……可乐饼……鲷鱼烧……某种奇怪的串签土豆……{i}这{/i}玩意儿叫什么来着……还有些我叫不出名字的东西……还有一只活鱿鱼。

lines.en: scene mayafestival21
: What am I supposed to do with a live squid?
lines.zh: : 你让我拿一只活鱿鱼怎么办？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I just blindly pointed at stuff from every booth and I guess I pointed at a live squid at some point.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我就是每个摊位都瞎指一通，大概有一下指到了活鱿鱼。

lines.en: : Can you go, like...kill it or something?
lines.zh: : 你能不能去……把它杀了之类的？

lines.en: : Asking me for my credit card is one thing. But asking me to {i}kill?{/i} You’re better than this, Maya.
lines.zh: : 问我要信用卡是一回事。可让我去{i}杀生{/i}？你不至于这样吧，Maya。

lines.en: : Am I? Because I’m pretty sure I’ve asked you to kill Noriko on several occasions and, if anything, I think I’d prefer to keep the squid alive if I had to choose between the two of them.
lines.zh: : 我不至于吗？我可记得我有好几次让你去杀了 Noriko，要说的话，如果非要在它俩之间选，我觉得我宁愿让鱿鱼活着。

lines.en: : I can’t wait until the day you two make up and start being friends. It’s going to be so sweet.
lines.zh: : 我等不及想看你们俩和好、变成朋友的那天了。那一定特别温馨。

lines.en: scene mayafestival22
: Ew, stop. At least wait until I finish eating to start saying stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 呕，别说了。至少等我吃完再说这种话。

lines.en: : Maya, there is so much food here that it is going to take you the rest of the festival to eat it all even {i}if{/i} you manage to eat at your normal breakneck pace.
lines.zh: : Maya，这儿的食物太多了，{i}就算{/i}你用平时那种拼命的速度吃，也得吃到祭典结束才吃得完。

lines.en: scene mayafestival23
: Do not underestimate my love for food.
lines.zh: : 别小看我对食物的爱。

lines.en: : Festivals are to me what the dorm rooms of [teenage]girls are to you- a place where I can be free. Where my hunger can never be sated.
lines.zh: : 祭典对我来说，就像 [teenage] 女生的宿舍房间对你来说一样——一个我可以自由自在的地方。一个我的饥饿永远得不到满足的地方。

lines.en: : I don’t know. My hunger is normally sated after half an hour or so. Sometimes, even less.
lines.zh: : 那可不好说。我的饥饿通常半小时左右就能满足。有时候还更短。

lines.en: scene mayafestival24
: Why do you say things like this to me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么总对我说这种话？

lines.en: : Because I know you won’t think any less of me.
lines.zh: : 因为我知道你不会因为这样就看轻我。

lines.en: : I literally can {i}not{/i} think any less of you.
lines.zh: : 我已经{i}不{/i}可能再看轻你了。

lines.en: : Yeah, exactly.
lines.zh: : 对，就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Itadakimasu.
lines.zh: : 我开动了。

lines.en: scene black
One by one, Maya tears into each plate and-
lines.zh: Maya 一盘接一盘地扫荡过去，然后——

lines.en: Well, I guess {i}tear{/i} probably isn’t the right word since she somehow manages to look graceful even while consuming more than some villages do in an entire week.
lines.zh: 好吧，“{i}扫荡{/i}”这个词大概不太合适，因为就算吃下比某些村庄一整周还多的量，她看上去依然优雅。

lines.en: But she eats everything without lessening her pace even once.
lines.zh: 但她把每一样都吃了下去，速度一次都没慢下来。

lines.en: The sun begins to set as she does so, and the air begins to turn a bit colder- but that’s to be expected since it is {i}technically{/i} still winter.
lines.zh: 她吃的时候太阳开始西沉，空气也渐渐转凉——不过这也是意料之中的，毕竟{i}严格来说{/i}现在还是冬天。

lines.en: Sure, the two of us were gifted a relatively warm day by Mother Nature, but only until it was time for her to go out and party with her other cougar friends.
lines.zh: 大自然母亲确实赏了我们一个相对暖和的日子，但只到她要出门跟她的美洲狮姐妹们狂欢为止。

lines.en: As Maya eats, well, {i}everything-{/i} I slowly pick at a bowl of ramen that, at least to my unrefined palate, doesn’t compare much to what Tsuneyo makes.
lines.zh: Maya 吃着——好吧，吃着{i}一切{/i}——我则慢慢挑着一碗拉面，至少以我这不讲究的舌头来说，它比不上 Tsuneyo 做的。

lines.en: But it’s warm enough to battle the encroaching cold and gives me something to do while waiting for the first stage of Maya’s favorite day of the year to end.
lines.zh: 但它足够暖，能抵挡渐渐逼近的寒意，也让我在等着 Maya 一年里最喜欢的这一天的第一阶段结束时有点事做。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
scene mayafestival25
Just as she said she would, Maya saves the watermelon for dessert.
lines.zh: Maya 如她所说，把瓜留到了最后当甜点。

lines.en: And yes, she did finish {i}everything-{/i} including the remainder of my ramen which, despite my worsening hunger, I was not able to finish.
lines.zh: 没错，她真的{i}全都{/i}吃完了——包括我那碗没吃完的拉面，尽管我越来越饿，还是没能吃完。

lines.en: I recall her saying in the past that she doesn’t like being watched while she eats and, this isn’t me being weird or...fetishy, but I’m glad she seemingly abandoned that insecurity today.
lines.zh: 我记得她以前说过不喜欢被人看着吃饭，这不是我奇怪或者……有什么癖好，但我很高兴她今天似乎放下了那份不安。

lines.en: There’s something oddly satisfying about seeing a girl so far detached from joy being enveloped by it that I can’t help but feel a little warmer inside.
lines.zh: 看着一个与喜悦如此隔绝的女孩被喜悦整个包裹住，有种说不出的满足感，让我心里也不禁暖了几分。

lines.en: Maybe that’s why I couldn’t finish my food.
lines.zh: 也许这就是我没能吃完的原因。

lines.en: I was already warm enough.
lines.zh: 我已经够暖了。

lines.en: : Enjoying yourself?
lines.zh: : 吃得开心吗？

lines.en: scene mayafestival26
: A bit.
lines.zh: : 有一点。

lines.en: Smile Count: 5
lines.zh: 微笑计数：5

lines.en: : And you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : For now. I’m sure that will change once I look at my credit card statement.
lines.zh: : 目前是。等我看到信用卡账单，肯定就不一样了。

lines.en: : At least Ami will still have a home when your house is repossessed.
lines.zh: : 至少等你的房子被收回去时，Ami 还有个家。

lines.en: : So, what’s the next phase of your game plan now that you’ve eaten from roughly every stand at this festival?
lines.zh: : 那么，你几乎把这场祭典每个摊子都吃遍了，下一步计划是什么？

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Have you changed your stance on goldfish at all in the last hour or so?
lines.zh: : 这一个小时里，你对金鱼的立场有改变吗？

lines.en: : I can’t say I have.
lines.zh: : 我只能说没有。

lines.en: : Then I suppose it would be best to avoid Kingyo-Sukui. Or any other games for that matter since you’re horrible at them and I don’t want any of the prizes.
lines.zh: : 那我看最好还是别去捞金鱼了。别的游戏也算了，反正你玩得烂，而且我也不想要那些奖品。

lines.en: : Pretty sure that just leaves more food, then.
lines.zh: : 那剩下的就只有继续吃了吧。

lines.en: : Don’t forget what day it is. We still need to visit a shrine and pay our respects for the year or god might kill us. That seems like a thing he would do.
lines.zh: : 别忘了今天是什么日子。我们还得去神社参拜，为这一年祈福，不然神可能会杀了我们。他看起来就会干这种事。

lines.en: : God sounds like an asshole.
lines.zh: : 神听起来像个混蛋。

lines.en: : You’re just realizing that now?
lines.zh: : 你现在才发现？

lines.en: : Nope. Just reinforcing the belief with some help from you.
lines.zh: : 不是。只是在你的帮助下加固这个信念罢了。

lines.en: : I guess we can get our fortunes while we’re there too. That seems like another...{i}festivaly{/i} thing to do.
lines.zh: : 我想我们还能顺便在那儿抽个签。那看起来也是件……很{i}有祭典感{/i}的事。

lines.en: : Not necessary.
lines.zh: : 没必要。

lines.en: : I draw the same one every time.
lines.zh: : 我每次抽到的都一样。

lines.en: scene black
We collect our garbage, dropping everything off at a nearby receptacle.
lines.zh: 我们把垃圾收拾好，全部扔进附近的垃圾桶。

lines.en: The squid (Still alive, albeit just barely) is left there as well- clinging to life atop a stack of dirty plates.
lines.zh: 那只鱿鱼（还活着，虽然只剩一口气）也被留在了那儿——在一摞脏盘子顶上苟延残喘。

lines.en: It covers its body in a variety of sauces, seasoning itself before death, in a desperate attempt to seek out water and prolong its unappreciated existence.
lines.zh: 它把身上涂满了各种酱汁，在死前给自己调了味，绝望地试图寻找水源，延长它那不被珍惜的生命。

lines.en: Neither of us have the heart to kill it, but we have the heart to watch it die.
lines.zh: 我们俩都没那个狠心杀它，却有那个狠心看着它死。

lines.en: And that must count for something.
lines.zh: 这总该算点什么吧。

lines.en: $ maya_love += 1
$ mayafestival2 = True
{i}Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump mayafestival3
